author: Rushmore State News
title: South Dakota volleyball releases 2026 season schedule
text:
South Dakota volleyball announced its 2026 full schedule on May 27, detailing a lineup that includes 10 regular season matches and one exhibition at the Sanford Coyote Sports Center.
The Coyotes will begin their preseason with an exhibition against Creighton, the reigning Big East champions, at DJ Sokol in Omaha, Nebraska, on August 16. The team then hosts Augustana for a final exhibition match at home on August 22 before starting nonconference play in Des Moines, Iowa, during the Drake Tournament from August 28 to August 30. South Dakota will face Drake on August 28, head coach Leanne Williamson’s alma mater Milwaukee on August 29, and DePaul on August 30.
In early September, South Dakota welcomes Utah Valley, Northern Iowa, and Air Force to Vermillion for the South Dakota Classic from September 3-5. The Coyotes open against Utah Valley Thursday night, followed by Northern Iowa Friday night and Air Force Saturday afternoon.
The following weekend features a tournament co-hosted by Colorado State and Wyoming. Matches include Colorado State in Fort Collins on September 10, Wyoming in Laramie on September 11, and UC Santa Barbara back in Fort Collins on September 12. The nonconference slate concludes with the South Dakota Lottery Classic at the Sanford Pentagon in Sioux Falls, where South Dakota plays Minnesota on September 18 and Washington on September 19.
Summit League play begins later in September with matches against South Dakota State both home and away. Other conference opponents include St. Thomas, Omaha, Oral Roberts, Kansas City, North Dakota State, and North Dakota through November. The Summit League Tournament is scheduled to take place in Brookings, with dates to be announced.
